g.text: Complement builds the repeat layout for a tile
Goal: cover a flattened space N = 16 by repeating the tile layout B = 4:1.
Cover N=16 by repeating tile B
C is the layout of repeats: shape(C)=4 means four repeats are needed; stride(C)=4 places starts at 0,4,8,12.
Each repeat starts at C(r); tile B fills positions C(r)+t.
C chooses repeat starts; B fills each repeat, so every flattened position appears once.
